description:
Once loved as the 'nation's little sister,' former child actress Park Se-jin finds herself with no casting offers and accumulating debt, working countless part-time jobs after her father commits fraud and flees. Then, a casting offer comes to Se-jin. The producer reportedly scouted Se-jin because he coveted her, and with an enormous appearance fee offered, she eagerly agrees to take the job. Enticed by the director's words about filming a 'realistic first night,' Se-jin soon finds herself, in reality, filming a scene entangled in one bed with four men from her in-laws...
